messages.content: What is the difference between augmented reality and virtual reality?

The difference between augmented reality (AR) and virtual reality (VR) lies in their immersive experiences; AR overlays digital content onto the real world, allowing users to interact with both real and virtual elements, while VR creates a completely immersive environment that isolates users from the real world.
